# ScanPlay

> ScanPlay (https://scanplay.org) turns a photo of your study notes into a revision game path (flashcards, quiz, listening, writing, dictation). Built for students on mobile and desktop.

## Product facts (authoritative)

- Website: https://scanplay.org
- Free to start: one trial scan without an account.
- That guest trial scan is free and does **not** consume the ScanPlay AI envelope. After creating a free account, AI usage starts empty.
- Guest trial is limited per device/browser. Refreshing, quitting, or reopening the site does not grant another free guest scan.
- After the trial scan, a free account is required to play steps and save progress.
- Free accounts include a **ScanPlay AI** envelope. Scans, coach, and summaries share the same usage percentage.
- Paid plans enlarge the ScanPlay AI envelope; nothing forces a paid upgrade.
- Supported input: images (photo of a sheet, textbook page, screenshot). PDFs not yet supported.
- Privacy: sheets are tied to the user account and are not public.

## Pix Universe: English course

- Ready English path inside the app (no photo scan required).
- Levels A1 to C2 (CEFR), 700+ lessons across dozens of chapters.
- Goals at onboarding: travel, work, school, exam, fun, or other.
- Lessons use vocabulary and example sentences; practice uses the same game styles as scanned paths.
- Hearts pace play (default cap on free; regenerates over time).
- Landing page (FR): https://scanplay.org/fr/apprendre-anglais/

## Pix Universe: Belgian driving theory

- Revision module for **Belgian** driving theory only (other countries are not available).
- Over 100 road signs with titles and meanings; 80+ multiple-choice questions; short practice sets and a 50-question mock exam.
- Independent study tool: **not** affiliated with official Belgian exam bodies; does **not** guarantee passing the official exam.
- Landing page (FR): https://scanplay.org/fr/permis-theorique-belge/

## FAQ (short)

Q: Is ScanPlay really free?
A: Yes. The first trial scan needs no account and does not use ScanPlay AI. Free accounts then get a ScanPlay AI envelope. Scans, coach, and summaries share the same usage percentage.

Q: Do I need an account?
A: Not for the first trial scan. An account is required to launch games and save progress. Guest trial is limited per device.

Q: Does the guest scan use the ScanPlay AI envelope?
A: No. The no-account trial scan does not bill the ScanPlay AI envelope.

Q: Can I learn English without scanning notes?
A: Yes. Pix Universe includes a ready English course (A1-C2). See https://scanplay.org/fr/apprendre-anglais/

Q: Is Belgian driving theory available?
A: Yes, Belgium only, in Pix Universe. See https://scanplay.org/fr/permis-theorique-belge/
